verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Ramp offering its own way to create recurring scheduled jobs or workflows. The CLI is described as suited to 'scripted/scheduled workflows', and agent keys support 'background agents that run on a schedule', but in both cases the scheduler is the user's external tool. Recurring budget intervals, spend-program templates, automated reminders and rules-based approval routing are related features, not user-defined schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
